text:
The Aldermoor hoard now belongs to the Lathe Street Gallery. The formal transfer took place on 14 March 2024, at a public ceremony in the gallery's main hall, where I watched the paperwork being signed.

Dr. Ingrid Valtanen, the gallery's Head of Collections, signed the acceptance of the transfer. The Aldermoor Hoard Transfer Agreement was then filed with the Aldermoor County Heritage Board, which holds the official record.

The hoard's inventory lists 312 objects, among them silver torcs, coins and brooches. Visitors who attended the ceremony were able to view a selection of the pieces after the signing.

Until now the collection has had no permanent home in a public museum. Under the agreement, it will remain in the care of the Lathe Street Gallery, whose collections team is responsible for its storage and handling.
